items.title: A gift every day until Christmas 🎄
items.text: From 1 to 24 December we post a new code every day on Instagram, Facebook, Threads and Bluesky (@afterzerogames) and on TikTok (@afterzero.games). A different gift every day: coffee beans, hints, chests, café income, a new look every Sunday and a Santa hat on the 24th. Every code works for 3 days: Settings › Redeem a code.
